content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Many platforms promise seamless integration and user-friendly experiences, but they often come with hidden costs and restrictions. Lemon Squeezy provides a straightforward way to sell digital products but is unavailable in numerous countries. Alternatives like Gumroad and PayPal face similar limitations. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a complete sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to build their own stores without depending on restrictive platforms. This means full control over sales, payment processing, and product delivery with no third-party intervention.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude creators in certain countries, citing regulatory concerns and high-risk categorizations. This results in creators facing exclusion from global markets and revenue opportunities. In stark contrast, COREMERCH's architecture is built for creators in these restricted regions, providing a solid alternative that does not discriminate based on geography. By leveraging decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, COREMERCH enables creators to process transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring access regardless of local banking limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms often impose high fees and delayed payment processes. For example, PayPal can freeze accounts for up to 180 days, leaving creators without access to their funds. In comparison, COREMERCH offers a transparent fee structure with a mere 0.5% fee for crypto transactions and near-instant payment confirmation through NOWPayments. This significantly reduces the real costs associated with selling digital products while ensuring that creators receive their funds without undue delays or holds.
Full ownership means you control your store without dependency on any platform.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor often overlooked with conventional platforms. With Lemon Squeezy or Gumroad, creators are essentially renting their access to the platform and its features. COREMERCH, however, provides full ownership of the digital store architecture after deployment, with no ongoing subscriptions. The automation of payment processing and product delivery is built-in, allowing creators to focus on their content while ensuring customers receive immediate access to purchases. This level of control and automation cannot be matched by conventional platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When considering which platform to adopt, the decision hinges on your specific needs and location. For creators in restricted countries, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) stands out as a robust choice. It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering both speed and reliability. This stack is deployed in just 48 hours and includes essential features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, making it a comprehensive solution that ensures immediate readiness for generating sales.

This allows you to build your online store with integrated crypto payment processing, bypassing the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms. This means full control and ownership of your sales process.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
